interface.title: matrix editor (version 0.9)
interface.stage_of_work: Collating aligned witnesses, building a stemma with external phylogenetics software, then reconstructing the archetype and producing a critical apparatus
interface.what_it_is_for: View and edit an alignment of manuscript witnesses one character or word at a time, export it for tree-building software, then load the resulting NeXML tree to reconstruct ancestral (archetype) readings by parsimony and add them to the matrix.

data.note: Uploaded c3.2.1-0.xml and c3.2.1-1.xml together through 'select CSV/XML file(s)'. The matrix showed 17 witness rows (D, K, V, A, O, L, G1, G2, M, P, H, T, CT, GV, V2, V3, K2). GV is empty in this passage. Then uploaded rooted-tree.xml and alternative-rooted-tree.xml through 'select NeXML file' in the Trees menu. No CSV file was tried.

features.name: Alignment grid with a linked running-text reader
features.general: Show many aligned sequences as a grid next to a readable view of one sequence; picking in either view highlights the same position in the other
features.specific: The Matrix pane (rows are witnesses, columns are aligned characters) beside a text pane opened from Texts; clicking a word highlights its column, and selecting columns highlights the word in the text
steps: Pick a witness from the Texts menu to open its text pane
Click a word in the text to highlight its matrix column
Drag across columns in the matrix to highlight the matching passage in the text
serves_tasks: Load several aligned source files into one comparison grid
Read one copy as running text, linked to the grid

features.name: Per-pane script transliteration
features.general: Show the same romanized text in other writing systems, pane by pane
features.specific: The 'A' change-script button on each pane cycles IAST → Devanagari → Telugu (the matrix stays in IAST). The Indic output is malformed: vowels appear as independent letters plus virama instead of vowel signs, so it cannot be used as correct Devanagari or Telugu text
steps: Press again to cycle to the next script
serves_tasks: Show the text in another writing system

features.name: Raw/normalized reading toggle
features.general: Switch the grid between readings as written and spelling-normalized readings, with normalized characters marked
features.specific: View > Normalized shows normalized forms in purple in the matrix and text panes (Column > (Re)normalize column is in the menu but was not tried)
steps: Compare the purple normalized forms in the matrix and text pane
serves_tasks: Switch between readings as written and spelling-normalized readings

features.name: Column annotation and grouping for variation units
features.general: Select one or more alignment positions and mark them as unimportant or group them into one unit, with undo
features.specific: Click or drag-select columns, then Column > Mark insignificant or Group columns; Edit > Group by whitespace groups whole words; Edit > Undo. Mark binary, Merge columns and Insert/Delete column are in the Column menu but were not run
steps: Click a cell, or drag across cells, to select columns
Choose Mark insignificant or Group columns
Check the greyed or boxed result; Undo if needed
serves_tasks: Flag a point of variation as not meaningful
Join adjacent positions into one unit of variation
Switch the units of variation from single characters to whole words

features.name: In-place cell editing
features.general: Correct a single value in the grid in place
features.specific: Select a cell, Cell > Edit cell, type the new reading, press Enter
serves_tasks: Correct one copy's reading at one position

features.name: Filtered character-matrix export for phylogenetics
features.general: Before exporting the alignment for tree-building software, choose which annotations shape the output (drop flagged positions, binarize, count gaps, merge groups, normalize)
features.specific: Export > NEXUS / CSV opens checkboxes (Remove insignificant lemmata, Binarize marked lemmata, Gaps are significant, Merge groups, Normalize spellings). No exported file was ever seen
steps: Choose NEXUS or CSV from Export
serves_tasks: Choose export filters and export the character matrix for tree-building software
Export the character matrix as a spreadsheet table

features.name: Apparatus export against a chosen base text
features.general: Generate a critical apparatus that records every copy's divergence from a chosen base text
features.specific: Export > TEI apparatus adds a Base text dropdown (including reconstructed witnesses such as Z) and options for the positive and negative apparatus (Merge groups, Normalized spellings). No exported file was ever seen
serves_tasks: Choose the base text and apparatus options for the edition

features.name: Per-position readings and ancestral readings on a family tree
features.general: Load a family tree of the sequences, see each leaf's value at the selected position, and inspect inferred ancestor values at internal nodes
features.specific: Trees > select NeXML file opens a tree pane; leaves show the readings of the selected column (e.g. 'P:ukta'); hovering a node shows its Fitch-parsimony reading in a tooltip
steps: Select a column in the matrix to see leaf readings
Hover internal nodes to see reconstructed readings
serves_tasks: Load a family tree and see each copy's reading at the selected position on its leaf
Check the inferred ancestral reading at an internal node

features.name: Reconstruct a tree node into a new witness row
features.general: Turn the inferred ancestor at a tree node into a whole reconstructed copy of the passage, with undecidable places marked, and compare reconstructions from differently rooted trees
features.specific: Clicking a node opens 'Label for node' and 'Add to matrix', which adds a new witness row whose text marks unresolved places as {x, y} (e.g. {ṃ, n}); a second tree can be loaded and another node added (Y beside Z). The replay confirmed the new row but not opening it from Texts or the {x, y} markers, which 041 shows
steps: Click a node in a loaded tree
Name it and press Add to matrix
Open the new witness from Texts
Optionally load a second tree and repeat
serves_tasks: Add the reconstructed ancestor as a new copy
Compare the reconstruction under a different rooting of the family tree

Ungrouping and regrouping lemmata (Column > Ungroup / Group columns) to reshape the units of variation before the apparatus export was not tried.
Mark binary, Merge columns, Insert/Delete column, Row > Insert row and Column > (Re)normalize column were not run.
View > Header (hiding the column-count row) was toggled but is display chrome, not a step of the work, so it is not in the tree.

Tagging variants as specific error types (scribal error, omission, shared innovation): the interface only offers Mark insignificant and Mark binary per column; there is no free-text or typed annotation of readings.
